description.value: 184 Pizza Corner is a locally owned pizza and Indian cuisine restaurant in Surrey's Cloverdale neighbourhood, open since 2007 and recognized as a neighbourhood favourite. The menu spans classic and specialty pizzas alongside a full Indian cuisine menu, with both pickup and delivery available through online ordering. A touring cyclist looking for a hot meal with variety in South Surrey will find this a convenient stop near 64 Avenue.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the Surrey-Cloverdale location details (address, phone, name) and establishes the business as open and active with online ordering. OSM tag takeaway=yes is corroborated by the website's 'Pick-Up or Delivery' ordering page. No evidence on the website or in OSM tags for bike parking, washrooms, water refill, wifi, or most other cycling amenities; the website does list an 'Alfredo Veggie Pizza' under specialty pizzas, confirming at least one vegetarian option.
concerns: Website notes 'Recently, we changed the name of our restaurant' — prior name unknown; current name on website matches OSM name '184 Pizza Corner'.
Website homepage presents two distinct locations (Surrey and Langley under separate brands); this record covers only the Surrey-Cloverdale location.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active pizza and Indian cuisine restaurant with confirmed address, phone, and online ordering. Useful stop for touring cyclists seeking a hot meal in South Surrey.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Website specialty pizza list includes 'Alfredo Veggie Pizza' confirming at least one vegetarian option
